answer: Each agent mints a kernel certificate by locking a bond equal to one epoch of expected rewards, held until a three-epoch horizon. Only unslashed kernels past that horizon become eligible for attestation. To stop a tide of cheap clones, every kernel must publish a live challenge nonce; established peers sample nonces each epoch and slash any pair that signs the same secret or repeats another kernel's nonce. A sybil attacker must fund a distinct locked bond per fake identity and keep unique live nonces through the whole horizon, or peers burn the colliding kernels at close.
